title: Spatio-temporal Latent Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Reduced-order Modeling of Parametrized Dynamical Systems
summary: Many scientific problems require accurate modeling of complex physical phenomena, such as fluid dynamics or climate modeling. These phenomena often result in high-dimensional and thus computationally expensive computational models that can limit their application to real-time and multi-query problems. Model-order reduction (MOR) is an approach that seeks to approximate full-order models (FOMs) using reduced-order models (ROMs), trading a minor reduction in accuracy for a major reduction in computational cost.
